description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) for employee salary components, including handling salary details and optional direct deposit information. It also manages validation rules, OpenAPI annotations for documentation, and interactions with the underlying data models and services.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class managing CRUD operations for employee salary components, including salary details and direct deposit info within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee salary component by employee number and component ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all salary components of a specific employee, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new salary component record for an employee, including optional direct deposit details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing salary component record for an employee, including direct deposit info.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified salary components for an employee by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing salary components.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a salary component, including nested direct deposit validations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting salary components.

methods.name: setEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Populates EmployeeSalary entity properties from request parameters.

methods.name: setEmployeeDirectDebitToEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Adds or removes direct deposit details to/from EmployeeSalary based on request data.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and salary component ID from request URL.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the request body, including conditional direct deposit validation.
